summary: Movim is a self-hosted, federated social network built on the XMPP protocol. It allows you to run a decentralised node supporting group chats, microblogging, and user subscriptions.
goodFor: It suits administrators who want to deploy a decentralised social platform integrated within the XMPP ecosystem.
watchOut: Federated software often requires careful configuration of domain routing, ports, and server-to-server communication to maintain network connectivity.
deployNotes: As a PHP and Docker application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
